jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: a lecture hall stage in thin white line art, a spotlight, rows of seats with an audience. Scene: view from the stage: rows of seats with an audience; EVERY person is drawn WHITE-filled (white skin, white hair, white clothes) with thin dark outlines, NOT black-filled, NOT dark clothes, no dark silhouettes; every person raises one hand high, eager faces. Normal human anatomy: each person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Each leg runs from the hip to ONE foot, the feet point the same way as the knees, no third foot or extra leg, and the legs of different people never merge or overlap; people in the background stand clearly apart from each other.
